source_receipt.description: Committed REST history remained pending for market startup; transaction had no matching delivery acknowledgement.

original_native_4d.description: Historical source replay repeatedly generated old realtime closes, revision rejection and recovery.

interrupted_history_native_restart.description: Cancelled background pages had not reached projection; history owner now prevents their replay as live events.

initial_harness_invocation.description: stdin-based pytest entry was incompatible with multiprocessing; rerun as python -m pytest, same selection retained.

superseded_ci.description: Concurrent frontend cache timing test exceeded 100 ms (122.9 ms); obsolete head cancelled by later product fixes. Threshold unchanged; final heads checked separately.

ci_display_clock.description: Simulated RAF used the real clock: a host pause can consume the normal 8 ms budget and defer the second display. The fixture now injects a fixed clock; production code and budget unchanged. All 15 display/scheduler tests pass including the explicit expensive-frame deferral test.
